full_prompt_en: A square gothic anime portrait shows a pale red-eyed figure with wild black hair and a crimson collar. The head fills most of the frame, cropped at the crown and shoulders, while the background is an almost black field opening into a blood-red patch at the lower left. Long dark strands cross the forehead and sweep across the left side, with thin sharp tips extending into the red. The figure turns in a slight three-quarter view and looks directly outward beneath heavily shadowed brows. The eyes are narrow and strikingly red, their small bright centers held inside deep charcoal sockets. A long nose, high pale cheek, and closed mouth are rendered in cold gray-white with dense black stipple and grain. The left half of the face is swallowed by shadow, while the right cheek and bridge of the nose remain brightly exposed. At the lower right, a raised crimson collar curves around the neck and shoulder; darker red etched patterning makes the fabric look heavy and ornate. Black clothing merges with the background beneath the collar. The composition has almost no depth beyond the close face and the dark-red color field, giving the eyes and pale skin an immediate presence. Fine crosshatched dots and rough ink lines give the otherwise broad black shapes a worn printed surface. Hard light seems to strike from the upper right, carving a sharp contrast between pale facial planes and the surrounding dark while allowing the red eyes and collar to glow. The overall composition is severe and theatrical, using tight cropping, granular black-and-white drawing, and selective crimson to sustain a brooding mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形哥特式动漫肖像呈现一位苍白、红眼人物，蓬乱黑发下围着绯红衣领。头部几乎填满画幅，在头顶与肩部被裁去；背景是一片近黑色域，在左下打开成血红色斑块。长深发丝经过额头并横扫左侧，纤细尖端伸入红色区域。人物以轻微四分之三角度转身，在深影眉下直接望向画外。眼睛狭长且鲜红，小亮点被浓炭黑眼窝围住。长鼻梁、高而浅的脸颊和闭合嘴巴以冷灰白色绘成，叠有密集黑色点纹和颗粒。半边脸被阴影吞没，另一侧面颊和鼻梁保持明亮外露。右下方，一道升起的绯红衣领绕过脖颈与肩部；更深红色刻画纹样让布料显得厚重华丽。领下黑衣融入背景。构图除贴近的面孔与深红色场外几乎没有纵深，让眼睛和浅色皮肤立即在场。细密交叉点纹与粗糙墨线赋予宽阔黑色形状磨旧的印刷表面。硬光似乎从右上方照来，在浅色面部平面与周围深暗之间刻出锋利对比，让红眼和红衣领发亮。整体构图严厉而戏剧化，以紧密裁切、颗粒黑白绘制和选择性绯红维持阴郁情绪。
style_prompt_en: The gothic graphic treatment relies on near-black fields, cold gray-white modeling, and a strictly concentrated crimson accent. Heavy ink shadow removes large sections of form, while fine stipple, short crosshatching, and rough grain articulate the surviving illuminated planes. Edges are sharply cut at the brightest focal details and fray into loose strands or speckled darkness elsewhere. Light is hard and directional, striking a small exposed region and leaving the surrounding mass almost completely dark. Red appears in narrow points and a larger lower band, making the accent feel intense without covering the image. Extreme close cropping compresses space and heightens the value contrast. The overall effect is brooding and theatrical, with a distressed printed surface and selective color giving spare shapes an ornate emotional weight.
style_prompt_zh: 这种哥特式图形处理依靠近黑色域、冷灰白塑形和严格集中的绯红重音。浓重墨影抹去大块形体，细点纹、短交叉排线和粗颗粒描出剩余受光平面。最亮焦点细节的边缘锋利，别处逐渐散成松散细丝或斑点深暗。光坚硬且有方向，只打在小片外露区域，使周围大块几乎全暗。红色成为狭窄亮点和较宽的下部色带，重音强烈却没有覆盖全画。极贴近的裁切压缩空间，强化明度对照。整体效果阴郁而戏剧化，磨旧印刷表面与选择性色彩给简练形状添上华饰般的情绪重量。
theme_en: A pale red-eyed figure with black hair and a crimson collar
theme_zh: 黑发、红眼、绯红衣领的苍白人物
name: Castlevania
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
